tagline.en: CSL's no-contract, pack-based prepaid platform — keep a Hong Kong number for about HK$15-28/year
tagline.zh: CSL 旗下无合约组合式储值平台——约 HK$15-28/年即可持有香港号码

description.en: Club Sim is CSL Mobile's self-service prepaid brand (HKT group, sister of csl/1O1O): buy service packs — local data, voice, Greater-China roaming, Asia-Pacific day passes — in the app or website with no contract and no admin fee. Its keep-alive rule is the standout: buying any pack within 365 days of the last keeps the number alive, with packs starting at HK$15.
description.zh: Club Sim 是 CSL Mobile（香港电讯 HKT 旗下，csl/1O1O 同门）的自助储值品牌：在 App/网站自选服务组合——本地数据、通话、中澳漫游、亚太日票——无合约、无行政费。最大卖点是保号规则：上次购组合后 365 天内再购任意组合即续命，最低组合 HK$15 起。

details.en:
Club Sim is not a travel eSIM store — it is a Hong Kong operator's official pack-based prepaid platform, and that is exactly its value. For number parking, the rule is simple and official: purchase any service pack within 365 days of your last purchase and the number stays yours; miss the window and the number is permanently deactivated and may be reassigned. The cheapest keep-alive is the HK$15 Asia 24-hour roaming pass; the cheapest local pack is HK$28 (5GB local data or unlimited local voice, 90 days / 1 month).

Mainland China usability (official): a dedicated China-Macau roaming zone sells 1GB/HK$38 and 3GB/HK$88 with 90-day validity, plug-and-play on arrival, with the operator advertising unrestricted social-app access; VoLTE and Wi-Fi Calling are supported (VoLTE requires a voice pack). Note the local voice pack explicitly excludes roaming voice and international calls.

Fine print that matters: new-SIM orders carry a minimum charge of HK$50 (buy a $28 pack and you must add items to reach $50, or pick a $58 pack); real-name registration under Hong Kong law is mandatory — unregistered SIMs are suspended — though visitors can register with a passport (this is statutory registration, not 'no-KYC'); eSIM issuance is free by email and physical-to-eSIM conversion is self-service in the app (more than one eSIM swap per year costs HK$40 each); no 5G — the ceiling is 4.5G at 42Mbps; packs are non-refundable. Community 'free-KYC' and MeSIM/Xesim-import claims are not confirmed by any official page and are treated as unverified.
details.zh:
Club Sim 不是旅行 eSIM 商店——它是香港运营商的官方组合式储值平台，而这恰恰是它的价值。保号规则官方明确：上次购买服务组合后 365 天内再购任意组合，号码即续命；错过窗口号码被永久停用并可能被分配给他人。最低保号成本是 HK$15 的亚洲 24 小时漫游通行证；最低本地组合 HK$28（5GB 本地数据 90 天，或本地通话短信组合 1 个月）。社区流传的「15 港币一年续期香港号」与官方规则吻合；「HK$6 套餐已取消」属实——$6 现只是通话组合内附送的短信包价值，无独立 $6 套餐。

内地可用性（官方口径）：设「中国内地及澳门漫游数据专区」，1GB/HK$38、3GB/HK$88，90 天有效期，抵埗即用，官方宣称各大社交 App 连接无障碍；支持 VoLTE 与 VoWiFi（Wi-Fi Calling），其中 VoLTE 需购买话音组合。注意本地通话组合明确不支持漫游语音与国际长途。

重要条款：新卡订单最低收费 HK$50（买 $28 组合须加购至 $50，或直接选 $58 组合达标）；实名登记按香港法例强制——未登记储值卡会被停用，访客可凭护照登记（这是法定登记，不是社区说的「免 KYC」）；eSIM 免卡费、付款后 QR 码邮件即达，实体↔eSIM 可 App 内自助互转（一年内换 eSIM 超 1 次每次收 HK$40，eSIM 转回实体须亲身赴门市）；暂不支持 5G（上限 4.5G 42Mbps）；组合一经订购不可退款；每账户最多 10 张卡，支持携号转台。社区提及的 MeSIM/Xesim 平台导入属非官方渠道，未核验。

bestFor.en: Parking a Hong Kong number for under HK$30/year; Greater-China roaming with 90-day validity; residents who want CSL-network quality without a contract
bestFor.zh: 每年不到 HK$30 保住香港号码；90 天长有效期的大湾区漫游；想要 CSL 网络品质又不要合约的用户

validity: Keep number: any pack within 365 days (min ~HK$15/year); data packs 90 days; monthly packs 1 month

note.en: CSL Mobile is a Hong Kong MNO: in Hong Kong, data exits on CSL's own mobile network. Roaming exits follow the visited network (China roaming rides mainland operators via CSL's roaming agreements); no public data on the landing IP type while roaming in the mainland.
note.zh: CSL Mobile 为香港自有网络运营商：在港数据出口为 CSL 自家移动网络。漫游时出口随落地网络（内地漫游经 CSL 漫游协议走内地运营商）；内地漫游时的落地 IP 性质无公开口径。
